comparison_plan: FP16 vs AWQ native: matched execution quantization baseline.
AWQ native vs wide-all: only wide launch implementation changes; require same-weight token equality across all four cells.
Wide-all vs hybrid: only M1 down36 routes change to GEMV;108 decode routes and all measured prefills remain wide; same-weight same-engine four-cell output gate required.
FP16 vs validated hybrid: optimized quantized implementation under matched system configuration; distinguish this from the native quantization result.
prerequisites: Current wide-all full-model output gate must pass before hybrid startup; otherwise stop or design a separate native-prefill variant.
New hybrid auditor must verify install/table/source/model identity,144 actual-stride warmups,36/108 graph capture and per-request routes.
Do not modify frozen primary/wide/qmax/hybrid sources during this study; no qmax combination in this configuration.
root_controls: Root selects a free base port and launches only after active GPU work and required gates complete.
